description: Eighteen faders whose values are gathered into polyphonic cables: each output carries a run of faders starting at its own, wrapping round the eighteen

params.text: Sets how many faders each output gathers into its cable, 1 to 16
Scales every fader's voltage, 0 to 10V for the full travel of a fader
Switches the faders between running from 0V upward and running either side of 0V, moving every fader to the matching position as it changes
Sets that layer's voltage, as a fraction of the depth setting

inputs.text: Changes the depth, added to the depth knob and clamped to -10 to 10V; a negative total turns every fader upside down while the faders themselves stay put

outputs.text: Carries the layers from its own one onward as polyphonic channels, as many as the layer count, wrapping round from the eighteenth back to the first

notes: an output with no cable is given no channels at all rather than 0V, which a destination reads as no cable rather than as a signal

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
